description: Hollowreed — a vendor of counterfeit event tickets migrates between three invented marketplaces (Tallow Bazaar, Quillmarket, Dunmere Exchange). saltmarsh, s4ltmarsh, and brine_wolf share PGP key FP3, wallet W3, and sign-off habits. Tallow Bazaar shares certificate CS-1001 with host 198.51.100.88. paperkite and ember_quill share weak writing habits but have concurrent activity. saltmarsh_official is an unverified self-claim decoy, W3/W4 exchange hot wallet is a financial decoy, and shared boilerplate is a weak text decoy.

personas.description: Likely same operator across migrations: saltmarsh, s4ltmarsh, and brine_wolf
